HEOR — Cost-Effectiveness & Outcomes
Health-economics board over 600 patient records across five indications: average cost per patient, cost per QALY and cohort size (filtered by indication), a patient-level cost-effectiveness cloud, cost per QALY by indication and treatment, and a 12-month budget-impact trend.
